en.name: Basilica of St. Anthony of Padua
en.summary: The burial church of St. Anthony of Padua, one of Italy's most visited pilgrimage basilicas.
en.body: Construction began in 1232, the year of St. Anthony's death, and the basilica has since held his tomb and relics, drawing pilgrims from across the world to the Franciscan saint known as the 'hammer of heretics.'
